descriptions.cxc3_seek_80208e34: Optionally save the previous position at +28; compute an unsigned candidate position from mode 0 (absolute), 1 (current position), or 2 (size at +32). Reject other modes with 0x90000002. Reject candidates above size with 0x90000003; otherwise store the candidate at +28 and return zero. Arithmetic wraps as a 32-bit unsigned value. Stream interpretation is inferred.
